raw:
@q query
  mode exists
  where all
    match
      relation "vote against"
      role subject ?d
      role object "the fishing quota"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be from"
      role subject ?d
      role object "Lithuania"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  quantifier at_least 2
